entry.name: jit.displays
entry.description: Senses additional display hardware attached to your computer and allows you to use standard Jitter get* and set* messages to enumerate the number and coordinates of any and all monitors. The object remembers the original state of your system's display settings when the object is instantiated, which can be easily recalled, and you can also use the object to enable display mirroring. Typically, the jit.displays object is saved as a portion of a performance patch setup to automatically determine the exact position of your attached hardware and move your output window as needed.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: Equivalent to themessage. Sends a count of the attached displays out the object's outlet in the form.

messages.name: coords
messages.description: Sends the display screen coordinates for the display whose index is specified out the object's right outlet as a list in the form. Displays are counted from 0 (0 is the primary display).

messages.name: count
messages.description: Sends a count of the attached displays out the object's outlet in the form.

messages.name: currentstate
messages.description: Sends the current state of the display out the object's outlet as a list in the form. Note that LCD displays report a refresh rate of 0.

messages.name: getmode
messages.description: Sends available display modes for display specified byout the right outlet as a sequence of lists, one display per line. Each display is described by a list in the form. Note: LCD displays have a refresh rate of 0.

messages.name: manual
messages.description: Sets the display to a configuration which provides the closest match for the ideal configuration specified by the arguments.

messages.name: mirror
messages.description: Enables video mirroring of the display whose number is specified byto the display whose number is specified by.

messages.name: move
messages.description: Changes the logical screen location of the display whose number is specified by. Two additional arguments specify the new screen location. If a location is chosen which overlaps with the location of another display, a new non-overlapping location will be automatically assigned. The final position of the display after acan be verified using themessage.

messages.name: reset
messages.digest: Return displays to their snapshot state
messages.description: Return displays to their snapshot state (see themethod). Note that reset does not have any affect on video mirroring settings, which must be maintained manually.

messages.name: setmode
messages.description: Change the display mode. The two arguments specify the display index, and the mode index (derived from themessage).

messages.name: snapshot
messages.description: Saves the current display mode (on all active displays) for use with theandmessages. A snapshot is automatically taken when the object is instantiated.

messages.name: unmirror
messages.description: Disables video mirroring on the specified display.
